"use client" import { useEffect, useState } from 'react' import api from '@/lib/api' import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation' export default function AdminDashboard() { const router = useRouter() const [user, setUser] = useState(null) const [stats, setStats] = useState(null) useEffect(() => { api.get('/me').then(res => setUser(res.data)).catch(() => router.push('/login')) api.get('/admin/stats').then(res => setStats(res.data)).catch(() => {}) }, []) const handleLogout = async () => { await api.post('/logout') router.push('/login') } return (

Admin Dashboard

{user?.email}

Admin Summary

Total users: {stats?.totalUsers ?? '—'}

{JSON.stringify(stats?.byRole || {}, null, 2)}

Users List

{stats?.users?.map((u: any) => (
{u.username} ({u.role})
{u.email}
))}
) }

import { cookies } from 'next/headers' import { redirect } from 'next/navigation' import Link from 'next/link' import { verifyToken } from '@/lib/tokens' import { db } from '@/lib/db' import LogoutButton from '@/components/LogoutButton' export default async function DashboardPage() { const cookieStore = await cookies() const token = cookieStore.get('token')?.value if (!token) { redirect('/login') } let user try { const decoded = verifyToken(token) as any user = db.users.find(u => u.id === decoded.userId) } catch (e) { redirect('/api/auth/logout') } if (!user) { redirect('/api/auth/logout') } return (

Dashboard

{user.email} — {user.role}

Welcome, {user.username}

You are signed in as {user.role}.

Go to Role Dashboard Home
) }

User Dashboard

{user?.email}

Roles Overview

You can see how many people are assigned to each role.

{roles.map(r => (
{r.name}
{r.count}
))}

Your Profile

{JSON.stringify(profile || {}, null, 2)}

Quick Actions

Request access, view your assignments, or contact admin.
) }
